tiles.title: Total Logs
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS logs FROM $logs_dataset WHERE ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE(app_name, 'unknown') = 'All')
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE(function_name, 'unknown') = 'All')
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE(workspace, 'unknown') = 'All')
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE(environment, "deployment.environment.name", 'unknown') = 'All')
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE(severity_text, level, file_descriptor, p_log_category, 'unknown') = 'All')

tiles.title: Total Traces
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT span_trace_id) AS traces FROM $traces_dataset WHERE ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') = 'All')
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE("deployment.environment.name", 'unknown') = 'All')
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE("modal.function.kind", 'unknown') = 'All')

tiles.title: Trace Error Rate
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE span_status_code = 2) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 2) AS error_rate_pct FROM $traces_dataset WHERE ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') = 'All')
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE("deployment.environment.name", 'unknown') = 'All')
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE("modal.function.kind", 'unknown') = 'All')

tiles.title: Logs and Traces Volume
tiles.chartQuery:
WITH l AS (SELECT date_bin('$bucket_size', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') time_bin, COUNT(*) logs FROM $logs_dataset WHERE ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE(app_name, 'unknown') = 'All')
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE(function_name, 'unknown') = 'All')
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE(workspace, 'unknown') = 'All')
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE(environment, "deployment.environment.name", 'unknown') = 'All')
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE(severity_text, level, file_descriptor, p_log_category, 'unknown') = 'All') GROUP BY time_bin),
tr AS (SELECT date_bin('$bucket_size', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') time_bin, COUNT(*) spans FROM $traces_dataset WHERE ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') = 'All')
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE("deployment.environment.name", 'unknown') = 'All')
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE("modal.function.kind", 'unknown') = 'All') GROUP BY time_bin)
SELECT COALESCE(l.time_bin,tr.time_bin) AS time_bin, COALESCE(logs,0) AS logs, COALESCE(spans,0) AS spans FROM l FULL OUTER JOIN tr ON l.time_bin=tr.time_bin ORDER BY time_bin ASC

tiles.title: Spans Over Time
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('$bucket_size', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin, COALESCE(span_name, 'unknown') AS span_name, COUNT(*) AS spans FROM $traces_dataset WHERE ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') = 'All')
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE("deployment.environment.name", 'unknown') = 'All')
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE("modal.function.kind", 'unknown') = 'All') GROUP BY time_bin, span_name ORDER BY time_bin ASC, span_name ASC

tiles.title: Trace Latency
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('$bucket_size', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin, ROUND(AVG(span_duration_ns/1000000.0),2) AS avg_ms, ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(span_duration_ns/1000000.0,0.95),2) AS p95_ms FROM $traces_dataset WHERE ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') = 'All')
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE("deployment.environment.name", 'unknown') = 'All')
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE("modal.function.kind", 'unknown') = 'All') GROUP BY time_bin ORDER BY time_bin ASC

tiles.title: Trace Errors Over Time
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('$bucket_size', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE span_status_code = 2) AS errors, COUNT(*) AS spans FROM $traces_dataset WHERE ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') = 'All')
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE("deployment.environment.name", 'unknown') = 'All')
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE("modal.function.kind", 'unknown') = 'All') GROUP BY time_bin ORDER BY time_bin ASC

tiles.title: Span Performance Summary
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COALESCE(span_name, 'unknown') AS span_name, COALESCE("modal.function.kind", 'unknown') AS function_kind, COUNT(*) AS spans, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE span_status_code = 2) AS errors, ROUND(AVG(span_duration_ns/1000000.0),2) AS avg_ms, ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(span_duration_ns/1000000.0,0.95),2) AS p95_ms FROM $traces_dataset WHERE ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') = 'All')
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE("deployment.environment.name", 'unknown') = 'All')
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE("modal.function.kind", 'unknown') = 'All') GROUP BY span_name, function_kind ORDER BY spans DESC

tiles.title: Recent Trace Detail
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT p_timestamp, span_trace_id, span_span_id, COALESCE(span_name,'unknown') AS span_name, COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') AS service_name, COALESCE("modal.function.kind", 'unknown') AS function_kind, ROUND(span_duration_ns/1000000.0,2) AS duration_ms, span_status_code, COALESCE(span_status_message, span_status_description) AS status_message FROM $traces_dataset WHERE ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') = 'All')
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE("deployment.environment.name", 'unknown') = 'All')
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE("modal.function.kind", 'unknown') = 'All') ORDER BY p_timestamp DESC LIMIT 50

tiles.title: Logs by Level
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('$bucket_size', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin, COALESCE(severity_text, level, file_descriptor, p_log_category, 'unknown') AS log_level, COUNT(*) AS logs FROM $logs_dataset WHERE ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE(app_name, 'unknown') = 'All')
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE(function_name, 'unknown') = 'All')
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE(workspace, 'unknown') = 'All')
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE(environment, "deployment.environment.name", 'unknown') = 'All')
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE(severity_text, level, file_descriptor, p_log_category, 'unknown') = 'All') GROUP BY time_bin, log_level ORDER BY time_bin ASC, log_level ASC

tiles.title: Logs by Function
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COALESCE(function_name, 'unknown') AS function_name, COUNT(*) AS logs FROM $logs_dataset WHERE ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE(app_name, 'unknown') = 'All')
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE(function_name, 'unknown') = 'All')
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE(workspace, 'unknown') = 'All')
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE(environment, "deployment.environment.name", 'unknown') = 'All')
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE(severity_text, level, file_descriptor, p_log_category, 'unknown') = 'All') GROUP BY function_name ORDER BY logs DESC LIMIT 20

tiles.title: Recent Error Logs
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT p_timestamp, COALESCE(severity_text, level, file_descriptor, p_log_category, 'unknown') AS log_level, COALESCE(app_name, 'unknown') AS app_name, COALESCE(function_name, 'unknown') AS function_name, trace_id, span_id, body FROM $logs_dataset WHERE ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE(app_name, 'unknown') = 'All')
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE(function_name, 'unknown') = 'All')
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE(workspace, 'unknown') = 'All')
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE(environment, "deployment.environment.name", 'unknown') = 'All')
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE(severity_text, level, file_descriptor, p_log_category, 'unknown') = 'All') AND (LOWER(COALESCE(severity_text, level, body, '')) LIKE '%error%' OR severity_number >= 17) ORDER BY p_timestamp DESC LIMIT 50

tiles.title: Recent Logs
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT p_timestamp, COALESCE(severity_text, level, file_descriptor, p_log_category, 'unknown') AS log_level, COALESCE(app_name, 'unknown') AS app_name, COALESCE(function_name, 'unknown') AS function_name, trace_id, span_id, body FROM $logs_dataset WHERE ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE(app_name, 'unknown') = 'All')
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE(function_name, 'unknown') = 'All')
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE(workspace, 'unknown') = 'All')
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE(environment, "deployment.environment.name", 'unknown') = 'All')
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE(severity_text, level, file_descriptor, p_log_category, 'unknown') = 'All') ORDER BY p_timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

tiles.title: Service Inventory
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') AS service_name, COALESCE("service.namespace", 'unknown') AS service_namespace, COALESCE("deployment.environment.name", 'unknown') AS environment, COALESCE("telemetry.sdk.language", 'unknown') AS sdk_language, COALESCE("telemetry.sdk.version", 'unknown') AS sdk_version, COUNT(*) AS spans FROM $traces_dataset WHERE ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') = 'All')
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE("deployment.environment.name", 'unknown') = 'All')
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE("modal.function.kind", 'unknown') = 'All') GROUP BY service_name, service_namespace, environment, sdk_language, sdk_version ORDER BY spans DESC

tiles.title: Logs with Trace Context
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT l.p_timestamp, l.trace_id, l.span_id, COALESCE(l.app_name, 'unknown') AS app_name, COALESCE(l.function_name, 'unknown') AS function_name, COALESCE(l.severity_text, l.level, 'unknown') AS log_level, t.span_name, ROUND(t.span_duration_ns/1000000.0,2) AS span_duration_ms, l.body FROM $logs_dataset l LEFT JOIN $traces_dataset t ON l.trace_id = t.span_trace_id AND l.span_id = t.span_span_id WHERE ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE(l.app_name, 'unknown') = 'All') AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE(l.function_name, 'unknown') = 'All') AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE(l.workspace, 'unknown') = 'All') AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE(l.environment, l."deployment.environment.name", 'unknown') = 'All') AND ('All' = 'All' OR COALESCE(l.severity_text, l.level, l.file_descriptor, l.p_log_category, 'unknown') = 'All') ORDER BY l.p_timestamp DESC LIMIT 100
